title: Part III
author: David Hume
summary: Cleanthes argues that a voice speaking from the clouds, or a library of living books, would point to a mind as plainly as the order of the world does. Demea objects that this makes God too like ourselves, and that the Deity's ways cannot be compared to ours.

notes.note: A transcription error: the 1779 printing has *not*.
Plotinus (c. 204–270), the founder of Neoplatonism, who held that the One, the first principle of all things, is beyond intellect and thought.
